scene: The plain glass jar with its lid off stands upright and empty on the plain table, nothing inside it but one crumb, and the small plain plate beside it has two crumbs and no cookies. The wall behind is plain.
must: an empty upright jar and a plate with only crumbs.
avoid: a plate with three cookies (over-rest); a jar full of cookies (vol); a jar with its lid on (dicht); a hungry face (not the card).
contrast: Pair with over-rest. The only difference is the cookies: none, only crumbs, here; three still on the plate there.
example_nl: De melk is op, ik haal nieuwe.
example_en: The milk is finished, I will get new.
alt: Een lege pot staat naast een bord met alleen kruimels.

scene: The plain glass jar with its lid off stands upright and empty on the plain table, and on the small plain plate beside it lie three whole round cookies, all the same size, in a loose row. The wall behind is plain.
must: three cookies on the plate next to an empty jar.
avoid: a plate with only crumbs (op-leeg); a jar full of cookies (vol); a plate with one huge cookie (groot); cookies in a pile of many (veel).
contrast: Pair with op-leeg. The only difference is the cookies: three still on the plate here, none but crumbs there.
example_nl: Er is nog soep over voor jou.
example_en: There is still soup left over for you.
alt: Een lege pot staat naast een bord met drie koekjes.

scene: The plain two-storey cutaway house shows one adult standing on the upper floor beside a plain bed, near the top of the staircase, with the lower floor empty except for a plain table. The pitched roof sits just above the adult's head.
must: the person on the upper floor beside a bed, the lower floor empty.
avoid: a person on the lower floor (beneden); a person on the roof outside (buiten); a person at the top step of the stairs only (bovenaan); a person standing on a table (not the card).
contrast: Pair with beneden. The only difference is the floor: the adult stands on the upper floor beside the bed here, on the lower floor beside the table there.
alt: Een man staat op de eerste verdieping van een huis, naast een bed.

scene: The plain two-storey cutaway house shows one adult standing on the lower floor beside a plain table, near the foot of the staircase, with the upper floor empty except for a plain bed. The ground line runs just under the adult's shoes.
must: the person on the lower floor beside a table, the upper floor empty.
avoid: a person on the upper floor (boven); a person in a cellar below the ground (not the card); a person at the bottom step only (onderaan); a person outside the house (buiten).
contrast: Pair with boven. The only difference is the floor: the adult stands on the lower floor beside the table here, on the upper floor beside the bed there.
example_nl: Wij eten beneden in de keuken.
example_en: We eat downstairs in the kitchen.
alt: Een man staat op de begane grond van een huis, naast een tafel.

scene: The adult, seen from behind, stretches the left arm straight out toward the plain tree with the small bird on the left half of the picture; the right arm hangs down. Both trees are the same size and the wall far ahead is plain.
must: the adult's left arm pointing at the tree on the left.
avoid: the right arm pointing at the right tree (rechts); both arms raised (not the card); the adult facing the viewer so the sides swap (not the frame); an arrow shape (not the style).
contrast: Pair with rechts. The only difference is the raised arm: the left arm pointing at the left tree here, the right arm pointing at the right tree there.
example_nl: De bank is links, naast de deur.
example_en: The bank is on the left, next to the door.
alt: Een man met zijn rug naar ons wijst met zijn arm naar de boom met de vogel; de andere boom is leeg.

scene: The adult, seen from behind, stretches the right arm straight out toward the plain tree on the right half of the picture, away from the bird; the left arm hangs down. Both trees are the same size and the wall far ahead is plain.
must: the adult's right arm pointing at the tree on the right.
avoid: the left arm pointing at the left tree (links); both arms raised (not the card); the adult facing the viewer so the sides swap (not the frame); an arrow shape (not the style).
contrast: Pair with links. The only difference is the raised arm: the right arm pointing at the right tree here, the left arm pointing at the left tree there.
example_en: The bus stop is on the right.
alt: Een man met zijn rug naar ons wijst met zijn arm naar de boom zonder vogel; in de andere boom zit een vogel.

scene: The flat field seen from slightly above is dotted with small plain flowers in every part: foreground, middle and far corner, dozens in all, spaced evenly. The adult stands at the bottom edge with arms hanging at the sides, looking into the field.
must: flowers spread over every part of the field.
avoid: a field with no flowers (nergens); flowers only in one corner (ergens); a dense solid mass of flowers (veel); a single big flower (groot).
contrast: Pair with nergens. The only difference is the flowers: spread over every part of the field here, absent from every part there.
example_nl: Overal in de stad staan fietsen.
example_en: There are bikes everywhere in the city.
alt: Een vrouw staat aan de rand van een veld met bloemen in elke hoek.

scene: The flat field seen from slightly above is bare plain ground from the foreground to the far corner, with no flower or plant anywhere. The adult stands at the bottom edge with arms hanging at the sides, looking out over the empty field.
must: a completely bare field from edge to edge.
avoid: a field full of flowers (overal); a field with one flower in a corner (ergens); a person sleeping on the field (not the card); a field of snow (not the frame).
contrast: Pair with overal. The only difference is the flowers: none anywhere here, spread over every part there.
example_nl: Ik kan mijn sleutels nergens vinden.
example_en: I cannot find my keys anywhere.
alt: Een vrouw staat aan de rand van een kaal veld zonder een enkele bloem.

scene: The adult is seen from behind, one foot already over the threshold of the open door, the other foot lifted, the body leaning forward into the open doorway. The short plain path behind the adult is empty and the door stands wide open.
must: a back-turned person stepping over the threshold into the doorway.
avoid: a person walking out of the door toward the viewer (naar buiten); a person standing inside the room (binnen); a person knocking at a shut door (not the card); a person on the path far from the door (not the card).
contrast: Pair with naar-buiten. The only difference is the direction: a back-turned person stepping into the doorway here, a front-facing person stepping out of it there.
example_nl: Kom maar naar binnen, het is koud.
alt: Een man met zijn rug naar ons zet een voet over de drempel van een open deur.

scene: The adult is seen from the front, one foot already over the threshold of the open door onto the path, the other foot still inside, the body leaning forward toward the viewer. The short plain path ahead of the adult is empty and the door stands wide open.
must: a front-facing person stepping over the threshold out of the doorway.
avoid: a person walking into the door away from the viewer (naar binnen); a person standing in the garden (buiten); a person leaning out of a window (not the card); a person with a suitcase on a road (onderweg).
contrast: Pair with naar-binnen. The only difference is the direction: a front-facing person stepping out of the doorway here, a back-turned person stepping into it there.
example_nl: De kinderen gaan naar buiten om te spelen.
example_en: The children are going outside to play.
alt: Een man kijkt ons aan en zet een voet over de drempel van een open deur op het pad.

scene: The left plate holds four whole round apples as always; the right plate holds eight apples in two tidy rows, clearly twice as many. Both plates are the same size, the table and the wall plain.
must: the right plate visibly fuller, with twice the apples of the left.
avoid: a right plate with one apple (minder); a right plate with four apples (evenveel); a right plate with one huge apple (groot); a basket of dozens (veel).
contrast: Pair with minder and evenveel. The only difference is the right plate: eight apples here, one in minder, four in evenveel.
example_en: I would like more coffee, please.
alt: Twee borden staan naast elkaar; het rechterbord heeft acht appels, het linkerbord vier.

scene: The left plate holds four whole round apples as always; the right plate holds just one apple in the middle of a bare plate. Both plates are the same size, the table and the wall plain.
must: the right plate with one apple against four on the left.
avoid: a right plate with eight apples (meer); a right plate with four apples (evenveel); an empty right plate (leeg); a tiny right plate (klein).
contrast: Pair with meer and evenveel. The only difference is the right plate: one apple here, eight in meer, four in evenveel.
example_nl: Ik drink minder koffie dan vroeger.
example_en: I drink less coffee than before.
alt: Twee borden staan naast elkaar; het rechterbord heeft één appel, het linkerbord vier.

scene: The left plate holds four whole round apples as always; the right plate also holds four apples in the same square arrangement, so the two plates look like mirror twins. Both plates are the same size, the table and the wall plain.
must: two plates with identical four-apple arrangements.
avoid: a right plate with eight apples (meer); a right plate with one apple (minder); two different fruits on the plates (not the card); one plate with eight apples (veel).
contrast: Pair with meer and minder. The only difference is the right plate: four apples in the same arrangement here, eight in meer, one in minder.
example_en: We have the same amount of money.
alt: Twee borden staan naast elkaar met precies dezelfde ronde vruchten in hetzelfde patroon.

scene: A plain park bench and one plain tree stand on the flat ground line under the open plain sky, seen from the front. High in the sky above the tree stands one round sun with short straight rays. Nothing else is in the sky, and the bench is empty.
must: a round sun with rays high in the sky.
avoid: a crescent moon in the sky (nachts); a sun low on the horizon (vroeg); a lamp shining indoors (aan); a cloudy sky with no sun (not the card).
contrast: Pair with nachts. The only difference is the body in the sky: a round sun with rays here, a crescent moon there.
example_nl: Overdag werk ik en 's avonds leer ik.
example_en: By day I work and in the evening I study.
alt: Een lege bank en een boom; hoog in de lucht staat een zon met stralen.

scene: A plain park bench and one plain tree stand on the flat ground line under the open plain sky, seen from the front. High in the sky above the tree hangs one crescent moon, drawn as a plain outline. Nothing else is in the sky, and the bench is empty.
must: a crescent moon high in the sky.
avoid: a round sun with rays (overdag); a lit window under a moon (laat); a plain dark box (donker); a person asleep in bed (not the card).
contrast: Pair with overdag. The only difference is the body in the sky: a crescent moon here, a round sun with rays there.
example_nl: 's Nachts is het stil in de straat.
example_en: At night it is quiet in the street.
alt: Een lege bank en een boom; hoog in de lucht staat een maansikkel.
